mainEntity.name: What are the common signs that my residential roof needs repair or replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs indicating your residential roof might need repair or replacement include missing, cracked, or curled shingles, especially after a storm. You might also notice granules from shingles accumulating in your gutters, which suggests wear. Inside your home, water stains on ceilings or walls, a sagging roof deck, or daylight visible through the attic are critical indicators of significant damage or leaks. A professional inspection can accurately assess the extent of the damage and recommend the best course of action.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs include missing or damaged shingles, granules in gutters, interior water stains, or a sagging roof. A professional inspection can confirm the need for repair or replacement.
